title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Irelands' citizenship and political participation Programme in Sierra Leone operates in Kailahun, Pujehun, Bombali, and Karene, with young women and men with disabilities. The programme plans to train 200 individuals with disabilities and support 25 youths in leadership roles, ensuring inclusive, accessible, and responsive governance systems for active citizenship. Key activities include advocating for youth with disabilities to obtain ID cards, voting cards, and registrations for elections; building the capacities of youth with disabilities to increase confidence and leadership skills; and supporting students with disabilities at one national university to participate in university governance. The overall aim of the project is to ensure that people with disabilities are included and able to participate in elections and political processes. In addition, the project aims to engage equal numbers of male and female participants.
